svg.title: Digital Heroes — Shopify Store Development Roadmap
svg.desc: A visual roadmap covering 11 phases from mindset to final delivery for building a professional Shopify store in 2 days.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why is the mindset so important before building a Shopify store?')
g.text: You are building a real, market-ready brand — not a test store

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Walk me through the Shopify store setup process step by step')
g.text: Partner account · Dev store · Theme · Pages · Nav · Currency · Timezone

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I build a professional brand identity for my Shopify store?')
sendPrompt('What makes a good product for a Shopify dropshipping store?')
g.text: 3–10 products · title · images · pricing · variants · SEO meta · collections

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Which Shopify apps should I install to maximise store conversions?')
sendPrompt('What sections should every high-converting Shopify homepage have?')
sendPrompt('What should each core page include in a Shopify store?')
g.text: About Us · Contact · FAQ · Shipping & Returns — real and polished, no placeholders

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I use Shopify Sidekick AI to improve my store?')
g.text: Product descriptions · homepage sections · copywriting · layout ideas

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What UX optimisations matter most on a Shopify product page?')
g.text: Product page: gallery · CTA · reviews · trust badges

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I test the full checkout flow on Shopify in test mode?')
sendPrompt('What design refinements make a Shopify store look truly professional?')
g.text: Spacing · alignment · color consistency · typography · image quality · mobile

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What files and links do I need to deliver at the end of the Shopify training?')

svg.text: Setup → Branding → Products → Homepage → Core pages → Apps → UX → Testing
Skip branding = amateur look · Skip homepage structure = low trust · Skip product quality = no conversion
